store.summary: Run P4wnP1 A.L.O.A. on the CardputerZero, without reflashing it
store.description:
The on-device panel for P4wnP1 A.L.O.A. running on the same CardputerZero. Compose USB gadget personas (keyboard, mouse, raw HID, RNDIS and CDC ECM networking, mass storage) and watch the endpoint budget before you deploy rather than after. Run stored HID payloads against an attached host, watch what is running, apply saved loadouts, and reboot or shut the device down.

It installs and removes as an ordinary package, so the device does not need a different OS image to become a USB rig. Networking is borrowed while a mode is armed and handed back on disarm, leaving the CardputerZero's own Wi-Fi settings working when the panel is not in use.

The panel reports what the service reports, and says how old the reading is. It cannot tell you whether an attached host accepted what was typed into it, and it does not pretend to.
